record.description: The LIFIS Cat Window Perch is a two-layer hammock featuring a metal frame and a removable plush mattress. It supports up to 55 lbs and attaches to windows using suction cups. The perch includes an adjustable height between 11 and 13.4 inches and is designed for windows with a minimum width of 17.7 inches.
The Merrell District MURI WRAP is a black women's slipper in size 05.0 M US. It features an M Select GRIP outsole designed to provide durable traction.

This 13 x 108-inch table runner features a black and white buffalo plaid pattern. Made from a cotton and polyester blend, it is designed to fit tables seating 8 to 10 people. The fabric is machine washable, shrink-resistant, and suitable for various indoor and outdoor occasions.

record.description: The Case Harley Tec X Linerlock is a black sporting goods item. It measures 2.8 x 4.8 x 13 centimeters and weighs 0.14 kilograms. This product was manufactured in China.

The CIRCUIT FITNESS Club Revolution is a red indoor cycle featuring a 30-pound flywheel with manual resistance. It includes a two-axis adjustable padded seat, aero-style handlebars, and Bluetooth connectivity. This home fitness bike also comes equipped with a water bottle holder and a phone/accessory holder.

This red camouflage backpack for children is made of water-resistant polyester and nylon. It features four compartments, a laptop sleeve, and two mesh side pockets for organization. The design includes adjustable padded shoulder straps, a top handle, and a hanging strap, measuring approximately 17"H x 12"W x 6"D.

This set includes two 52 x 84-inch linen blended curtain panels in a dove pattern. The open weave fabric provides privacy while allowing diffused light to enter the room. Each panel features eight nickel grommets for rods up to 1 1/4 inches wide. These curtains are machine washable and tumble dry safe.

Sally Hansen Xtreme Wear nail polish in the shade Iris Illusion offers a durable finish with high shine. This 0.4 fl oz bottle provides a vibrant, on-trend color. The package contains one bottle of polish.

This black mug tree by Spectrum Diversified Ashley holds up to six mugs or teacups of various sizes. It features curved branches for vertical storage and a looped handle for easy transport. Measuring 8" L x 6.75" W x 16.5" H, it is designed for use on kitchen countertops or coffee bars.

This shadow-colored Carhartt jacket from the Company Gear Collection is sized medium. It features Rain defender durable water repellent and Rugged flex durable stretch technology. The design includes a mighty back bi-swing and flex elbows to provide increased mobility and ease of movement.

This grey laundry hamper set includes one 74L basket and two 120L removable bags. Constructed from 600D Oxford fabric with four fiber rods for stability, the hamper measures 24.5 x 13 x 13 inches. It features a foldable design, allowing it to collapse for compact storage or travel.
This officially licensed Taito prize figure features Echidna from the Re:Zero series in a Mandarin Dress. The collectible model includes a base stand and is available in multiple colors.

This Columbia women's down jacket features 700 fill power goose down insulation and Omni-Heat thermal reflection. The waterproof and breathable Omni-Tech shell includes 4-way stretch material. It features a removable, helmet-compatible hood, underarm venting, a zippered waist pocket, adjustable cuffs, a drawcord hem, and a drop tail.

specs.features: Anti-skid grips, smooth heel tab, elastic ankle

record.description: CozyWay non-slip socks for infants and toddlers feature rubberized anti-skid grips on the soles to provide traction. Made from breathable, medium-thickness combed cotton, these socks include a smooth heel tab and soft elastic ankle bands. They are available in multiple colors and sizes ranging from 0-6M to 3-5T.

This 50x80cm unframed canvas print features Edward Hopper's "People in The Sun." Produced using high-definition inkjet printing on glossy canvas, the piece offers vivid colors and durable construction. It is suitable for various home or office settings and is individually packaged for safe delivery.

This grey Van Heusen men's dress shirt is made from poplin fabric. It features a fitted cut with a tapered waist, roomier shoulders, and a point collar. The shirt includes an adjustable cuff, a chest pocket, and a wrinkle-free finish. It is size X-Large US with a 17.5 neck and 36-37 sleeve.

The Radio Flyer Classic Red Wagon features an all-steel body, 10-inch rubber tires, and a folding pull handle. It is designed to transport cargo or children and includes a controlled turning radius. The wagon measures 39.5 inches long and is recommended for children aged 1.5 years and up.

This Vanity Fair wirefree bra in Star White provides full coverage with lightly lined cups. It is made from smooth, silky fabric and features convertible straps that can be adjusted into traditional or crisscross styles. This 38C bra includes a hook and eye closure for a secure fit.

specs.Material: Wheat straw fiber and food-grade PP

record.description: This 4-piece set includes 24 oz bowls made from wheat straw fiber and food-grade PP. These lightweight, unbreakable bowls are BPA-free and safe for use in the microwave and dishwasher. Designed with smooth edges and a deep shape, they are suitable for serving cereal, soup, salad, and noodles.

This blue "ONE" cake topper by WAOUH is designed for a baby boy's first birthday celebration. Made from high-quality cardboard with a sparkly glitter finish, the pre-made decoration is non-toxic and residue-free. It can be used as a cake topper or a prop for photo shoots.

These Oilite (SAE 841) sintered bronze flanged sleeve bearings are self-lubricating and maintenance-free. Made primarily of copper, they are wear-resistant and corrosion-resistant. They are suitable for general purpose applications with moderate speeds and loads. Dimensions include a 12 mm ID, 15 mm OD, 12 mm length, 18 mm flange diameter, and 1.5 mm flange thickness.

The HP DesignJet T100 is a compact 24-inch large-format plotter designed for small offices and home environments. It supports both sheet and roll media and includes an automatic cutter. Connectivity options include Wi-Fi, Ethernet, and USB 2.0, with mobile printing support for Android, Chrome OS, and iOS.

This five-pack of white Hanes sleeveless bodysuits is designed for babies aged 6 to 12 months. The fabric features 4-way stretch for flexibility and includes expandable shoulders to simplify dressing. Each bodysuit is constructed with reinforced snaps for increased durability.

This three-piece set includes 1-1/2, 3, and 5-quart mixing bowls made from commercial-grade stainless steel. The stackable bowls are dishwasher, refrigerator, and freezer safe. Designed for durability, they resist stains and odors, making them suitable for mixing, marinating, and serving.

This burnt orange Romwe summer dress features a V-neckline, short butterfly sleeves, and an all-over print. It has a high-waisted A-line silhouette and is designed for casual daily wear. The non-stretch fabric is machine or hand washable.

This DMLSKY lanyard features a green cactus design and is constructed from soft polyester fabric. It measures 19.2 inches long and 1 inch wide. The set includes a metal key clasp and an ID holder that can accommodate two cards.

This women's short-sleeve t-shirt features a "I Smell Children" letter print and Sanderson Sisters graphic. Made from a soft, breathable cotton blend, it has a casual loose fit and an o-neck design. The shirt is suitable for various seasons and can be paired with jeans, leggings, or boots.

specs.Card Slots: 9 credit card slots, 1 photo slot, 3 removable sleeve slots

record.description: This compact bi-fold wallet is made from top-grain cowhide leather with an embossed checkered pattern. It features RFID-blocking technology, nine card slots, a photo slot, a coin pocket, a full-length bill compartment, and a removable card sleeve. Measuring 4.72 x 3.93 x 0.48 inches, it includes a zipper pocket and a snap closure.

This Ziploc set includes eight roll-up travel bags to maximize storage space without a vacuum. The set contains three large suitcase bags (18" L x 22 1/2" W) and five medium carry-on bags (13 1/2" L x 19 1/2" W). These bags protect contents from dirt, odors, and pests.

The ASICS Gel-Excite 4 is a women's running shoe designed for moderate mileage. It features a rubber sole, a low-top shaft, and a removable sockliner to accommodate orthotics. The shoe includes a Rearfoot GEL Cushioning System to attenuate shock and an ahar outsole for increased wear resistance.

This white 3-cube storage organizer from ClosetMaid features an open back and a sturdy frame. It measures approximately 43.98 inches high, 15.87 inches wide, and 13.5 inches deep. The unit can be displayed vertically or horizontally and is compatible with 13-inch decorative fabric bins.

specs.Material: Patent PU leather and polyester lining

record.description: This brown handbag is made of patent PU leather with a polyester lining. It features a rectangular briefcase design, a top handle, and a detachable metal chain strap. Equipped with a magnetic snap and zipper closure, it measures 29x6.5x18cm and can be used as a tote, clutch, or crossbody bag.

This blue protective case is designed specifically for the iPhone XR. It features a clear frosted PC back with a 3D floral design and a soft TPU bumper for shock resistance. The slim case supports wireless charging and includes precise cutouts for easy access to all ports and buttons.

This black short-sleeve baby bodysuit features a retro 90s sitcom quote. It is made from soft, pre-shrunk ring-spun cotton and includes a snap crotch for easy changes. The garment is OEKO-TEX STANDARD 100 certified and is printed in Austin, Texas.
These Ariat women's Dahlia Western cowboy boots feature a Silly Brown/Chocolate Floral design. The footwear includes a Duratread outsole and is a size 11 M US.

These electric running boards for 2016-2019 Nissan Titan and Titan XD models automatically extend and retract. They feature integrated LED lighting, a 600-pound weight capacity per side, and a corrosion-resistant aluminum alloy finish. The system includes pinch-proof technology and is manufactured in the USA with a five-year limited warranty.

This 18-inch necklace chain is crafted from 925 sterling silver with a rhodium plating for a polished finish. It features a 0.8mm box chain design and a lobster claw clasp. The hypoallergenic, nickel-free construction ensures it is suitable for sensitive skin while remaining lightweight for daily wear.
This green Rockin Gear pencil eraser features a jumbo shark shape. It is designed for use in school, homework, and office environments to remove large pencil marks from paper.

This navy midi dress features a striped pattern and a curvy sheath silhouette. Constructed from 100% polyester stretch fabric, it includes short cap sleeves, a round neckline, and a hidden back zip. It is suitable for casual, business, or church occasions.
This chrome aerator is designed for use with Delta Neo Style lavatory faucets. It features a 2.2 GPM flow rate and a 55/64 in. - 27 female thread size. The product is manufactured in China.

This bright white Perry Ellis shirt features a slim fit and rolled sleeves. Made from a lightweight linen and cotton blend, it includes a narrow collar and is machine washable. The design is suitable for various occasions, from business casual to weekend wear.

This men's Goodthreads t-shirt is made from soft, lightweight jersey slub cotton. It features a V-neckline, a front pocket, and a slim, fitted silhouette. The shirt is colored in Pampas/Yellow and is a size large.

This black rubber floor mat by Rubber-Cal measures 3 feet by 4 feet and is 1/8 inch thick. It features a textured, non-slip surface for use on ramps, boat docks, and walkways. The lightweight mat is suitable for indoor or outdoor use and protects subfloors in high-traffic areas.

specs.Care: Machine wash cold, tumble dry low

record.description: This 50 x 60-inch white throw blanket is made of 100% cotton and features a diamond pattern with decorative fringe. It is designed for use as a decorative accent, a picnic blanket, or for warmth. The cotton fabric is machine washable and tumble dryable.

This 10-inch angel food cake pan by Nordic Ware is constructed from heavy aluminum to provide even heat distribution during baking. It features a nonstick coating for easier food release and cleaning. This USA-made pan is designed for hand washing with mild detergent.

specs.Material: Hard plastic back and flexible bumper

record.description: This TORRAS clear case for the iPhone 11 Pro Max features a hard plastic back and a flexible silicone bumper. It utilizes non-yellowing technology for clarity and includes shockproof corners for drop protection. The slim design maintains the phone's original profile and is compatible with wireless chargers.

These black ECCO Helsinki oxfords feature a bike-toe design with blind-eyelet lacing and double-stitched seams. The interior includes a moisture-wicking lining and a ventilation system. The shoes are finished with a direct injected one-component PU outsole featuring a shock point.

The Regalo Easy Open baby gate is a steel pressure-mounted gate that fits openings between 29 and 47 inches wide. Standing 30 inches tall, it features a walk-through door and includes 4-inch and 12-inch extension kits. It is JPMA and ASTM certified for use with children aged 6-24 months and pets.

The adidas Predator 20.3 is a men's low-cut soccer shoe designed for use on artificial turf. It features a regular fit and a Demonscale 3D-print strike zone. This pair is finished in a Core Black, White, and Active Red colorway and is a size 11.5.

This sand-colored triangle sun shade sail measures 12' x 12' x 12' and is constructed from 185 GSM HDPE material. It provides up to 95% UV protection and features a breathable, water-permeable design. The set includes three 5-foot ropes and a hardware kit for outdoor installation.

SATINA high-waisted flare palazzo pants are made from soft peachskin fabric consisting of 92% polyester and 8% spandex. These wide-leg pants feature a supportive waistband designed to prevent sagging. They are available in Chakra Blue and require hand washing and hanging to dry.

This queen-sized comforter set from Basic Beyond includes a reversible comforter and two matching pillow shams. Constructed with brushed microfiber and a plush polyester fill, the set provides all-season warmth. It features a grey color scheme and is machine washable for convenient care.

The CrazyFire LED headlamp provides 800 lumens of light using a CREE XM-L T6 bulb. It features three lighting modes—high, low, and strobe—along with a zoomable beam. The unit is IP50 waterproof, weighs 7.3oz, and includes a 90-degree adjustable head. It is powered by three AA batteries, which are sold separately.

This five-count box of Atkins Protein Wafer Crisps features a lemon vanilla flavor. Each wafer includes a sweet vanilla coating and lemon filling. They contain 11 grams of protein, 5 grams of fiber, 4 grams of net carbs, and 1 gram of sugar per serving. These snacks are keto-friendly.

These Ariat women's mid-rise bootcut jeans are made from a cotton and Lycra blend for stretch and comfort. They are flame-resistant and meet NFPA 70E, NFPA 2112, and CAT 2 safety standards. The jeans feature an Oceanside Entwined pattern and embroidered back pocket details.

These grey ULTRAIDEAS women's slippers feature a wool-like plush fleece lining and a high-density memory foam insole. They include a non-slip rubber sole suitable for indoor and outdoor use. These machine-washable, slip-on shoes are designed to stretch slightly to provide a customized fit after initial wear.

specs.construction: Triple-stitched seams, brass rivets, heavy-duty brass zipper

record.description: These Dickies carpenter jeans are made from 100% cotton lightweight duck fabric in a timber color. They feature a relaxed straight fit, triple-stitched seams, and brass rivets. The design includes a utility pocket, hammer loop, and five-pocket styling with a heavy-duty brass zipper.

This MABELLA ring set includes a women's engagement ring with a 7x7mm round brilliant cut cubic zirconia stone and a men's 8mm wide band. The rings are made from 316L stainless steel, which is nickel-free and non-tarnish. The set comes in a gift box and is sized for women's size 7 and men's size 10.

The Snapzoom Universal Binocular Tripod Mount allows binoculars without a built-in threaded tripod socket to be attached to a tripod. It features a standard 1/4"-20 screw thread and is designed for compatibility with a wide range of binocular models.

These black Acorn spa thongs feature a plush terry upper and an open-toe flip flop design. The shoes include a memory foam insole with arch support and a skid-resistant rubber sole for indoor and outdoor use. They are machine washable and dryable.

specs.Features: Accu-fit Technology, Arch Support, Seamless Toe Closure

record.description: These black over-the-calf socks provide 15-20 mmHg of moderate graduated compression for women's shoe sizes 8-11. They feature arch support, a seamless toe closure, and moisture-management yarns. These socks are designed for everyday wear, travel, exercise, and professions requiring prolonged standing or sitting.

This Zattcas women's tunic shirt features a notch neck and 3/4 roll tab sleeves. Made from a polyester and spandex blend, the top offers a loose fit and a high-low hem. It is solid black and sized Large (US 12-14), designed for comfortable wear with various bottoms.

This black Samsonite luggage strap is made with a polypropylene strap and an ABS buckle. It is adjustable to fit bags up to 72 inches in length and features a distinct design for easier identification. This strap does not include a lock.

These taupe ankle booties from Cambridge Select feature a Western-inspired design with a V-slit front and a pointed toe. They include a 1.5-inch stacked block heel, a padded footbed, and an inner zip for easy wear. Constructed from vegan man-made materials, these boots offer a lightweight silhouette for daily use.

This 69-piece sticker set features designs from the cartoon show Futurama. Made of PVC, the decals range in size from 1 to 3 inches. They are suitable for use on various surfaces, including laptops, skateboards, backpacks, and bicycles, and are intended for both children and adults.

These black and white Crocs sandals for women feature LiteRide foam insoles for cushioning and Croslite foam outsoles for support. The design includes flexible gore uppers and a relaxed fit. This pair is a size 8.

This Hallmark Shoebox birthday card features modern lettering on a sunrise background. It includes a humorous interior message and measures 5" x 7.2". Printed on high-quality paper stock, the card comes with a coordinating envelope.

Ja-vie women's dress shoes in Gold Cap/Parrot Green (EU size 35) feature a cotton knit lining and a cushioned leather insole with arch support. The slip-resistant jelly outsole provides flexibility. These machine-washable flats include airvents for breathability and are suitable for walking, driving, and daily use.

This XO4U graphic t-shirt features a Swiss Alpine design. It is made from lightweight material and offers a classic fit. The garment includes double-needle stitching on the sleeves and bottom hem, making it a suitable souvenir or gift for travel and outdoor activities.

This 25-foot roll of Frost King pipe wrap features a natural cotton material with a foil backing. Measuring 3 inches by 1 inch, it is designed to insulate and reduce vibrations on heating and AC ducts. It has a Class A fire rating and is easy to install without special protective gear.

The Klarstein Passionata Rossa is a red espresso and cappuccino machine featuring 20 bars of pressure and 1,350 watts of power. It includes a steam nozzle for frothing milk, a 1.3-quart water tank, and a brushed stainless-steel finish. The unit is compatible with ground coffee and espresso pods.

This 20-inch Dynacraft Air Zone Badlands freestyle BMX bike features a deluxe paint finish and 48-spoke wheels. It is equipped with front and rear u-brakes, front and rear pegs, and a freestyle rotor.

specs.Material: Solid wood, high density fiberboard, and solid veneer
specs.Features: Locking top lid, vanity mirror, ring rolls

record.description: This walnut-colored jewelry armoire by Hives and Honey is constructed from solid wood, high density fiberboard, and solid veneer. It features a locking top lid with a vanity mirror, ring rolls, and eight pull-out drawers. The unit includes side doors with necklace hooks and requires no assembly.

specs.Included Accessories: Carry bag, repair kit, 2 hoses, 5 stakes

record.description: This 18 x 17 x 9.5 ft inflatable water park features two slides, a climbing wall, a splash pool, and a water cannon. Made from puncture-resistant 420D oxford fabric with PVC coating, it is ASTM certified. It accommodates up to four children aged 3 to 10 and includes a carry bag, repair kit, hoses, and stakes.

The Coolerplus FC112 is a white, wired optical mouse featuring a 1000 DPI sensor and three buttons. It includes a rubber scroll wheel, rainbow LED lighting, and a 1.6-meter USB cable. This plug-and-play device is compatible with Windows and MAC OS X systems for use with laptops and desktops.

These mid-calf Sorel boots feature waterproof suede leather uppers and a warm faux fur lining. They are constructed with a handcrafted vulcanized rubber shell, a 2.5mm bonded felt frost plug, and a herringbone outsole. The seam-sealed design provides water protection in a dark gray and black colorway.

VAVA individual eyelash extensions are made from faux mink material with a classic curl. These lashes measure 8mm in length and 0.25mm in thickness. They feature a metallic film backing to help prevent residue during application, making them suitable for professional salon use.

This two-pack of Gildan men's long sleeve t-shirts in Sport Grey features moisture-wicking stay-cool fabric. The shirts include reinforced neck tape, spandex cuffs for stretch, and a design with dropped shoulders and straight armholes. They are constructed to prevent twisted side seams after washing.

The Bali Lilyette Endless Smooth Minimizer Underwire Bra in Body Beige Tonal (size 40D) features a 2-ply back for smoothing and shaping. It is designed to reduce projection by up to 1.5 inches. This bra includes wider set straps, an open underwire for comfort, and an open neckline.

This 48-inch yellow gymnastics mat features a 15.5-degree incline and a trapezoidal wedge shape. It is filled with high-density EPE pearl foam for firm support during tumbling, stretching, or yoga. The mat weighs approximately 11 lbs, is stackable for storage, and includes a zipper seal for a removable inner liner.

specs.Flexibility: Arms in, out, or one of each

record.description: This SwaddleMe WrapSack is designed for infants aged 0-3 months weighing 7-14 pounds. It features a bottom zipper for easy diaper changes and hook and loop fasteners to secure the swaddle wings. The versatile design allows for different arm positions and helps prevent the startle reflex.

This necklace features a small number 1 pendant crafted from solid 14k white gold. The pendant has a brushed satin finish and measures 14.32mm in length and 3.81mm in width. It is laser-etched, hypoallergenic, and includes a certificate of authenticity and gift packaging.

The Gear4 Piccadilly Clear Case for iPhone X/XS features a slim white design with bevelled edges. It utilizes D3O material for impact protection and is drop tested up to 10 feet. The case includes a UV scratch-resistant coating and precision cut-outs for easy access to all buttons and ports.

These GLOBALWIN women's ankle boots feature a grey and black faux leather exterior with quilted side panels. They include a faux fur lining and padded collar for warmth. The rubber soles are water-resistant and slip-resistant, providing support and breathability for outdoor activities during fall and winter.

These black Amazon Essentials men's jeans feature a slim-fit bootcut design with a 17-inch leg opening. Made from stretch denim, they include classic five-pocket styling and sit below the waist. The fit is slim through the thigh and widens at the ankle. This pair is size 34W x 28L.

This Timex women's watch features a 38mm polished silver-tone case and a white dial with Arabic numerals and 24-hour military time. It includes an Indiglo light-up feature and a reversible blue nylon slip-thru strap with a floral and swirl print. The watch is water-resistant up to 30 meters.

specs.Features: D-ring, adjustable ankle toggles, scissors pocket

record.description: These black KOI cargo style scrub pants are designed for women in size XX-Large Petite. They feature a low-rise fit with a drawstring waistband and multiple pockets, including a dedicated scissors pocket. Additional details include a D-ring on the left leg and adjustable toggles at the ankles.

This girls' one-piece swimsuit features a pet dog print and is made from a smooth, stretchy blend of 80% polyamide and 20% elasthane. It is designed for quick drying and ease of movement, making it suitable for swimming, beach activities, and parties.

This officially licensed Marvel t-shirt features Miles Morales from the Spider-Verse. It is designed with a classic fit and lightweight fabric. The garment includes double-needle stitching on the sleeves and bottom hem.

The Kalolary 10 Color Temporary Hair Color Chalk Set includes a comb for applying various colors to natural hair. These washable chalks are suitable for children, teens, and pets for temporary use during events like parties or cosplay. The color can be removed from hair using shampoo and water.

specs.Features: Mesh top, cushioned ventilated sole, silicone heel grip

record.description: This three-pack of black Hue women's liners features an ultra-low, no-show design. They are constructed with a soft mesh top and a cushioned, ventilated sole for breathability. Each pair includes a silicone heel grip to keep the liners in place and fits shoe sizes 4 through 10.

specs.Features: Quick Select buttons, On-screen setup assistant

This model includes Bluetooth, a USB port, and HEOS Link for wireless music streaming. It also features an on-screen setup assistant and four Quick Select buttons for easy switching between inputs.

This foldable TroyStudio vocal booth is a portable microphone isolation shield designed to reduce echoes and room noise. It features 2-inch high-density egg crate foam on all interior surfaces. The lightweight box is compatible with various microphones and stands, making it suitable for home studios, podcasts, and voice-over recording.

specs.Material: 100% cotton washed canvas and 100% polyester mesh

record.description: This musk green Carhartt cap features a cotton washed canvas front and a polyester mesh back. It has a structured medium-profile design with a pre-curved sandwich visor and a front patch applique. The hat includes an odor-fighting sweatband and moisture-wicking FastDry technology for added comfort.

This Epson EF-100 laser projector features built-in Android TV for streaming and Google Assistant voice search. It uses Microlaser Array technology to project images up to 150 inches. The unit includes an internal bass-reflex speaker, a 3.5mm stereo output, and a compact black design.

Nike women's Court Royale AC sneakers feature a retro tennis-inspired design in a black and white colorway. These shoes are constructed with a leather upper, traditional lacing, and an autoclave-fused midsole and outsole. They include a soft fabric lining, a comfort footbed, and a solid rubber outsole with a herringbone pattern.

specs.Storage: 12 elastic loops, 6 mesh segments, 2 mesh pockets

record.description: This black Jelly Comb electronics organizer is made of water-resistant nylon. It features a two-layer interior with elastic loops for cables, mesh segments for USB drives, and a pocket for tablets up to 7.9 inches. The bag includes two zippers, a detachable hand strap, and padded covers for portable storage.

This Under Armour tote features a water-resistant UA Storm finish and a large main compartment with an oversized zipper pull. It includes double webbing straps for multiple carrying options. The bag measures 20.3"W x 12.6"L x 9.8"H and provides a 25 L capacity.

The Nike Air Zoom Mariah Flyknit Racer updates a classic 1980s design with modern technology. These lightweight shoes feature a Flyknit upper with a sock-like fit, Zoom Air cushioning, a heel pull tab, and a durable rubber outsole.

This Yotache magnetic screen door measures 38"W x 81"H and fits doors up to 36"W x 80"H. Constructed from 18 x 16 mesh fiberglass, it features reinforced stitching and webbing. The screen includes magnetic closures and windproof hook&loop hasps. Installation accessories like push pins and hook&loop tape are included.

This 5x8 foot teal blue area rug by JOYFEEL features a 1.57-inch long shaggy pile and a high-density sponge layer for sound absorption. It includes a non-slip bottom with durable dots to prevent sliding. Suitable for various rooms, including bedrooms and living areas, this plush rug provides a soft surface for home decor.

This blue long-sleeve henley shirt for men is made from an oxford fabric blend of 80% cotton and 20% polyester. It features a mandarin collar, chest buttons, and roll tab sleeves. Designed with a regular fit and straight-cut waist, it is suitable for casual wear or various costume themes.

The JEF World of Golf Professional Large Realistic Putting Training Mat measures 3 feet by 10 feet and features a high-quality turf surface with a padded rubber base. Suitable for indoor and outdoor use, it includes two holes with flags and provides a 2-foot by 8-foot 6-inch inner putting area.

This manual focus 35mm F1.2 lens is designed for Canon EOS-M mirrorless cameras. It features a large aperture, a Sonner optical structure with six elements in five groups, and a multi-layer coating. The lens is constructed with a copper core aluminum shell and a crescent-shaped focus ring.

This set of two Homemory flameless candles features a moving flame LED and a waterproof design for indoor and outdoor use. Made from ivory frosted plastic, these battery-operated candles include a remote control with adjustable brightness and timers. Each candle measures 6 inches tall and 3.25 inches in diameter.

specs.Ideal For: Mountaineering, Cycling, Skiing, Snowboarding, Training, Hiking

record.description: This STARK SOUL thermal underwear set in black and blue is designed for winter sports and outdoor activities. Made from high-elastic sports fabric, it features double-seamless technology and three-dimensional elasticity for muscle support. The garment is breathable, flexible, and moisture-absorbing to provide warmth during exercise.

This PChero USB to 2.0mm charging cable is compatible with Mini S530 wireless headphones and Bluetooth shower speakers. The 30cm cable features a 2.0mm diameter and 12.0mm length DC tip. It connects to various USB power sources, including wall adapters, power banks, and laptop ports.

This 13-inch cube storage box is made of 100% polyester and is designed to fit most cube shelving units. It features a front pull tab for easy access and a felt animal appliqué decoration. It is suitable for organizing items for children, toddlers, or pets.

This 15L grey insulated lunch bag features a double-layer design to keep food items separated. It includes a leakproof PEVA liner that is easy to clean and provides up to 7 hours of temperature retention. The lightweight tote is suitable for office use, picnics, or as a general-purpose bag.

record.description: This set of four multicolor rice bowls is handcrafted from stoneware in England. These durable bowls are safe for use in the oven, microwave, freezer, and dishwasher.

This multi-purpose cat furniture combines a scratching block with a lounging chaise. Constructed from corrugate cardboard that resembles tree bark, it features catnip integrated into the layers to release fragrance as cats scratch. It is designed to encourage healthy nail growth and offers a cozy spot for feline relaxation.

This navy blue midi dress from ASTR the label features a sleeveless fit and flare silhouette crafted from lace. The garment is partially lined and designed with a contemporary fit that runs small. This item is a size medium, corresponding to sizes 6-8.

L'Occitane Cherry Blossom Bath & Shower Gel is a 8.4 fl oz body wash suitable for sensitive skin. It gently cleanses the skin and leaves a cherry blossom scent. Apply to wet skin, lather, and rinse for a fragranced shower.
The WIX 57502XP is an automotive oil filter manufactured in China. This product weighs 0.75 pounds and has dimensions of 3.12 inches in length, 3.12 inches in width, and 5.06 inches in height.

This large 100% nylon beach blanket measures 82.7 x 78.7 inches and accommodates 4 to 8 adults. It is water-resistant, quick-drying, and sand-resistant. The mat includes four pockets and four ground stakes for wind protection. Its lightweight, portable design makes it suitable for camping, hiking, picnics, and various other outdoor activities.

The CO-Z flush mount ceiling light fixture features a chrome-finished metal dome and 143 K9 crystal balls. Measuring 12 by 12 by 6.1 inches, it accommodates two E26 bulbs up to 60W each. This dimmable fixture is suitable for various rooms, including hallways, dining rooms, and kitchens.

This size 7 ring features a 1.22 ct round halo of clear cubic zirconia stones set in rhodium-plated 925 sterling silver. The design includes a pavé band and is hypoallergenic and nickel-free. It comes packaged in a leather box.

This Japanese anime-themed wallet case is designed for iPhone 11, 11 Pro, and 11 Pro Max models. It features three card slots, a cash pocket, and an auto wake/sleep function. Constructed from TPU and PU leather, it provides shockproof protection and includes a multi-angle stand for convenient viewing.

specs.Compatibility: Casement, tilting, and bottom hung windows

record.description: This 158-inch waterproof nylon window seal is designed for casement, tilting, and bottom-hung windows. It uses adhesive hook tape and a zipper to secure portable air conditioner or tumble dryer hoses, blocking outside air from entering the room. The kit is washable, easy to install without drilling, and fits various hose diameters.

This 19” x 24” dish drying mat features a low-profile design and absorbent polyester fabric with a waterproof, slip-resistant backing. It protects countertops from spills and scratches while providing a stable surface for drying dishes. The mat is machine washable, durable, and made in the USA using over 50% recycled fibers.

The Jiee Tec SUNTEK Solar Panel provides backup power for hunting and game trail cameras. It features a 2500 mAH lithium polymer battery and a safeguard circuit to protect against overcharging and overdischarging. This weatherproof, IP 65-rated device is compatible with various Suntek series models and can be mounted on trees, poles, or tripods.

These black Russell Athletic men's mesh shorts feature a 9-inch inseam and an X-Large size. They are constructed with breathable mesh and Dri-Power moisture-wicking technology. The shorts include an elastic waistband with an internal draw cord for adjustability and side pockets for small items.

This white long-sleeve blouse features a slim fit and a ribbed knit texture. It includes a cross wrap design with an asymmetrical neckline. Made from a polyester, cotton, and spandex blend, this pullover top is machine washable and suitable for various outfits.

These dark blue clip-on heel wheels attach to regular shoes to create roller skates for children aged 6 and up. They feature LED lights that activate as the wheels turn without requiring batteries. The adjustable design supports up to 132 lbs and includes a rubber strap and large brakes for safety.

specs.Compatible Surfaces: Plastic, whiteboard, glass, paper, wood, metal, ceramic

record.description: Chartpak Graphic Art Tape is a white matte tape measuring 1/8 inch wide and 324 inches long. It features a permanent adhesive and durable construction for indoor and outdoor use. It works on surfaces including plastic, whiteboard, glass, paper, wood, metal, and ceramic for crafts, signage, and decorations.

specs.Dimensions: 54.53 L x 29.92 W x 18.90 H Inches

record.description: This wood toddler bed from Delta Children features a Nick Jr. PAW Patrol design. Suitable for children aged 15 months and older, it includes two high side rails for safety. The JPMA-certified bed measures 54.53 x 29.92 x 18.90 inches and is designed for easy assembly.

This set includes two ivory sheer curtain panels, each measuring 52 by 84 inches. Made from linen-textured fabric, these curtains feature a grommet top and a 0.4-inch bottom hem. They allow light and airflow into a room while providing privacy. These machine-washable panels are suitable for various home interiors.

This 11 x 14 inch Amazon Basics whiteboard features a magnetic dry erase surface and a lightweight aluminum frame. It includes a black marker with a built-in eraser, two magnets, and self-stick pads for mounting. The board can be hung horizontally or vertically to display notes, lists, or photos.

This 12-piece set includes five sandwich bags, five snack bags, two large storage bags, and two sealing clips. Made from food-grade PEVA, these transparent, BPA-free bags are leak-proof and freezer-safe. They are suitable for storing food, snacks, and personal items. Hand wash and air dry after use.

This Carter's 7-pack contains long-sleeve bodysuits for baby girls in size 18M. The set features assorted colors and designs. Each bodysuit includes strong snaps for closure, designed to withstand repeated wear and washing.

specs.Key Ingredients: Amla fruit extract, proline, glycine, hyaluronic acid
specs.Allergen-Free: Free of soy, nuts, eggs, and shellfish

record.description: PlantFusion Collagen Builder is a vegan, gluten-free vanilla protein powder designed to support collagen production, skin hydration, and joint health. It contains amla fruit extract, proline, glycine, and hyaluronic acid. This non-GMO formula is free from dairy, soy, and common allergens, and can be mixed into smoothies, shakes, or coffee.

specs.Fragrance Notes: Pumpkin puree, sweet butter, vanilla cream

record.description: This set includes six Bath & Body Works Sweet Cinnamon Pumpkin Wallflower refill bulbs, packaged as three twin-packs. The fragrance features notes of pumpkin puree, sweet butter, and vanilla cream. These bulbs are compatible with Wallflower Fragrance Plugs and Night-Lights. This is a discontinued item.

specs.Included Items: Candy, Cookies, Chocolates, Wafers, Biscuits, Pretzels
specs.Origin Countries: Russia, Romania, Croatia, Serbia, Ukraine, Latvia, Macedonia

record.description: This snack box contains at least eight pre-packaged treats from various Eastern European countries, including Russia, Romania, and Croatia. The assortment features a variety of items such as cookies, chocolates, wafers, biscuits, and pretzels. Each box offers a different combination of authentic snacks.

This black skull-shaped gear shifter knob is constructed from resin and aluminum alloy. It fits most manual and automatic vehicles with shifter levers measuring 8mm to 12mm in diameter. The set includes three adapters, a spanner, and four screws for installation. It is not suitable for shifters with buttons or pull-up reverse gears.

This ivory plastic pearl set includes 200 no-hole beads in three sizes: 20mm, 14mm, and 10mm. It also comes with six packets of transparent water gels designed to make the pearls float. These polished beads are suitable for use as vase fillers or table scatter for weddings, parties, and home decorations.

specs.Included Items: Modes Bassinet Stroller, SnugRide SnugLock 35 Infant Car Seat

record.description: The Graco Modes Bassinet Travel System in Wynton includes a stroller that converts into an infant bassinet, an infant car seat carrier, and a toddler stroller. It also includes a SnugRide SnugLock 35 infant car seat. This system provides nine riding options and a one-step attachment for the car seat.

This white, hi-grade plastic tray is designed to hold 24-inch flower boxes. It is lightweight and fade-resistant, providing a protective surface for decks, patios, or indoor areas. Measuring 22.25 inches long by 6.5 inches wide, this tray is made in the USA.

This light blue undershelf storage basket features a steel metal frame with a rust-resistant PE finish. It includes snug fit arms designed to attach to cabinets, desks, or other shelves to create additional storage space. The medium-sized basket measures 10.25 x 16 x 5.5 inches and weighs 12 ounces.

This 24k gold-plated heart locket measures 0.75" x 0.5" and can hold up to two photos. It is available with or without an 18-inch curb link chain. Made in the USA, the locket comes in a black velvet pouch and includes a lifetime replacement guarantee.

This Kaweco fountain pen is made of high-quality brass and features a 23 K gold-plated steel fine nib. It weighs 21 grams and measures 13 cm with the cap attached. Handmade in Nuremberg, this pocket-sized pen is designed for a soft writing experience.

These blue volume lash extensions by WENDY LASHES feature a 0.07mm thickness and lengths ranging from 14-20mm. The lashes are heat-treated for curl stability and include a sticky root treatment to prevent fan separation. They are designed to help technicians create 4D to 10D volume effects.

This weathered white wall-mounted coat rack by Ilyapa features five metal hooks on a distressed wood base. Measuring 24 by 4.5 inches, it has a 30-pound weight capacity. The product includes mounting hardware and is suitable for organizing coats, hats, and bags in various areas of the home.

specs.compatibility: Fishing, hunting, and duck hunting waders

record.description: This stainless steel wader hanger is designed to hold fishing, hunting, and duck hunting waders off the ground. Constructed from 1/4'' steel, it supports over 200 pounds and features a chain design to help maintain the shape of the gear while it dries.

specs.Exterior: Bonded fleece with grid knit texture

record.description: This Spyder men's jacket features a 100% polyester bonded fleece exterior with a grid knit texture. It is lined with Sherpa fleece and includes a full zip closure. The garment also has two side zipper pockets and embroidered branding on the front and back.

These pet stairs are designed for small, medium, and large dogs to access higher surfaces like beds or couches. Made from blow-molded plastic, they feature a removable carpet tread for easy cleaning and a slight incline to reduce the number of steps needed.

specs.Functions: Black ballpoint, red ballpoint, pencil, stylus, eraser

record.description: This satin black Cross Tech3+ multifunction pen features a chrome clip and banding. It includes a black ballpoint, red ballpoint, 0.5mm pencil, stylus, and eraser. The pen offers up to 25 characters of custom silver-colored engraving and comes with a lifetime mechanical warranty and a gift box.

This black short-sleeve t-shirt features the "Raider True 'Til The Day I'm Through" design. Made by Smack Apparel Inc., the garment is constructed from 100% pre-shrunk cotton and is machine washable. It is screen printed in the USA and is available in size X-Large.

specs.Footbed: Soft EVA with anatomical arch support

record.description: These aqua and green Reef sandals for little kids feature a soft EVA footbed with anatomical arch support. They are built with flexible Triple Density EVA and a vegan leather upper strap with a jersey lining. The high density EVA outsole provides multi-directional traction.

This white adidas Real Madrid 2019-20 home jersey features a regular fit with a straight silhouette and crewneck. It is made from 100% recycled polyester doubleknit and includes sweat-wicking Climalite fabric with mesh inserts under the arms. The jersey also features a woven Real Madrid crest.
This Hyperkin cable connects Saturn consoles to HDTVs, supporting 720p resolution for clear audio and video. The set includes a 7 ft. main cable and a 6 ft. micro cable.

These replacement lenses are designed to fit Oakley Holbrook frames with model numbers starting with OO9102 (55mm size). They feature a dark silver mirror coating with 6% light transmission and a 1.4 mm thickness. The lenses are polarized, provide UV protection, and meet ANSI Z80.3 standards for impact resistance.

The Bionica Nimah thong sandal features fabric straps and a soft nubuck toe post. It includes a quick-drying molded EVA footbed with arch support, a heel cup, and a toe bar. The design is finished with a shock-absorbing EVA midsole and a durable, slip-resistant rubber outsole.

The JW Pet Company Skid Stop Basic Pet Bowl is a jumbo-sized dish designed for extra large breed dogs. It features a heavyweight construction and a rubber bottom to prevent sliding on smooth surfaces like tile. This dishwasher-safe bowl is available in various colors.

This officially licensed LEGO Batman grid wall poster by Trends International measures 22.375" x 34". Printed on FSC-certified gloss poster paper, it features high-resolution artwork. The unframed poster is suitable for various rooms and can be displayed using poster mounts, clips, or thumb tacks.

This three-pack of Carter's toddler tank tops for boys includes three different designs in blue, orange, and gray. The sleeveless shirts feature a ribbed neckline and a pocket detail. These 3T size tops are designed for everyday wear and come in tagless packaging.

This pack of 75 BOX USA double wall Gaylord bottom boxes measures 48" L x 40" W x 36" H. Made from 275# D.W./ECT-48 kraft corrugated material, they are suitable for consolidating bulky or irregularly shaped items. These boxes are compatible with Gaylord lids and ship flat in pallet quantities.

specs.charging: External USB port and headphone hole

record.description: This black Seoky Rop sling bag is made from water-resistant PU leather and features adjustable nylon straps. It includes multiple compartments, an anti-theft interlayer, an external USB charging port, and a headphone hole. The bag measures 13.8 x 6.7 x 3.2 inches and weighs 0.69 lb.

This 5.5-inch hand-painted resin figure by Willow Tree depicts an older woman and a young girl holding hands on a gray bench. Based on an original carving by Susan Lordi, the piece is suitable for display on a mantel or shelf. It includes an enclosure card and comes in a fitted gift box.

specs.Key Features: Replaceable wire cutters, blade exchanger, one-hand opening

record.description: The Leatherman Surge is a heavy-duty stainless steel multitool equipped with 21 tools, including large pliers and spring-action scissors. It features a blade exchanger, replaceable wire cutters, and one-hand opening functionality. The tool includes a premium nylon sheath and is covered by a 25-year warranty.

This white short-sleeved chef's jacket for women features a double-breasted design with a 10-button closure that can be worn both ways. The set includes a matching chef hat with Velcro fasteners for an adjustable fit. This product is size small.

DiNeop 3MM neoprene gloves provide thermal protection and a flexible fit for water activities like snorkeling, kayaking, and surfing. They feature an anti-slip textured palm, an adjustable velcro wrist strap, and glued and blind stitching for durability. These gloves are available in various sizes for men, women, and children.

specs.Care: Machine washable cold, tumble dry low

record.description: WallFlower Women's Juniors denim shortalls in Belle feature adjustable straps, a center zipper closure, and multiple pockets. These size small shortalls are made with LYCRA and have a 3-inch cuffed inseam. They are machine washable in cold water and can be tumble dried on low.

The LENTION CB-C31 is a space gray USB-C hub featuring four USB 3.0 ports with data transfer speeds up to 5Gbps. It includes a Type-C port supporting up to 60W power delivery. Constructed from aluminum alloy, this adapter is compatible with various laptops, including MacBook, Surface, and Chromebook devices.

This official Alex Grey poster features the Oversoul artwork. The museum-quality print measures 18 by 24 inches and includes a quote about human consciousness being a bridge between planetary and cosmic consciousness.

The ALPS Mountaineering Low Rocker Chair features a powder-coated steel frame and breathable TechMesh fabric. This foldable chair weighs 11 pounds and supports up to 300 pounds. It includes a shoulder bag for transport and a low-profile rocker that locks into place for stability.

This pack of two Size D batteries is official merchandise from Trick Or Treat Studios and Universal Studios. Based on footage from the movie Child's Play 2, these batteries are intended as an accessory for a Good Guys Doll.
